text: Stopping relies on the brakes as the main system, alongside the tires, though braking is the dominant method. Rim, disc, and drum options exist for the braking mechanism; each applies force to the wheels differently to reduce speed. Tires manage shock absorption and ensure a smooth ride. Maintaining tires through checks of pressure, tread depth, and rim integrity is necessary for safe and efficient operation. When these parts function correctly, cyclists gain access to exercise and the enjoyment provided by this accessible mode of transport.
